title: The World's Most 'Intelligent' Cities in the AI Age
paragraphs: Which cities are making the best use of artificial intelligence? A new ranking says that London is the world's most "intelligent" city.

The ranking is called the Intelligent Cities Index 2026, and it was published in late July 2026 by the consulting company Boston Consulting Group, or BCG. It is the first time the company has made this index. It looked at 61 of the world's biggest cities in 39 countries.

BCG studied how cities use AI and other digital technology to improve life for the people who live there. Each city was scored in five areas. These were the results for residents, the city's AI strategy, how much AI is used, the way the city government works and things like funding, talent and infrastructure. Then the cities were put into four groups: leading, accelerating, emerging and developing.

London came first, with a score of 85. Dubai was second, followed by New York City, Washington, DC, and Amsterdam, which all scored 80. The rest of the top 10 were Berlin, San Francisco, Shanghai, Beijing and Seoul. Singapore was just behind, in 11th place.

No city was the best in every area. London was first for results for residents, and Madrid had the best AI strategy. Dubai was first for using AI, New York City led in the way its government works, and Amsterdam was the top city for funding, talent and infrastructure.

The report found that people who use generative AI most often are also the most positive about how it will affect their lives. It also found that cities can make life better with AI services even if they do not have the best infrastructure or a lot of money. Cities in Africa, Asia and the Middle East showed some of the strongest interest in generative AI.

Akram Awad, one of the authors of the report, said that "AI is a key foundation of the intelligent city." However, the ranking is based on one company's methods. Other rankings, such as the IMD Smart City Index, have different results. In that index, Zurich was first in 2026.
